narratives.body: OneFootball, Yardbarker, and Yahoo report that RB Leipzig coach Martín Demichelis has praised Yan Diomande ahead of the Champions League clash between Real Madrid and Leipzig at the Bernabéu.
narratives.headline: Demichelis praises Diomande ahead of Madrid clash

narratives.body: Goal.com reports that Martín Demichelis insists Franco Mastantuono is built for Real Madrid despite his loan spell at Fiorentina, noting the player needs time.
narratives.headline: Demichelis: Mastantuono built for Real Madrid
